(7 comments)
The effecter is using Sensor.Value interface. It is rejected by Patrick as the comment in the design spec https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/docs/+/68927

The ValueIntf isn't used here. It's my bad that I didn't clean it from the include header. This patch aims to just add the base infrastructure/support for effecters. The interfaces for each effecter would be added later on and would be unique to the effecter.
Not reviewed fully but added few comments. You can address them. Also think of splitting this bug commit if possible*.
Lot of function in this file are unused - Or may be not required, Do cross check once.
Where are these used?
const std::string&
Same here for better readability
Here also we need to refresh the value using "co_await getNumericEffecterValue();" Else it might have different value if error is only with response decode.
